description: This file contains implementations for higher-order ONNX operators such as 'cond' and 'scan' within the PyTorch ONNX exporter. It defines wrapper functions to create and handle IR nodes for these operators, facilitating dynamic graph construction and integration with ONNX runtime.

methods.name: Sequence[ir.Value] call_op( op_type: str, *args: ir.Value, _num_outputs: int = 1, _domain: str = "", **kwargs: int | float | str | bool | ir.Graph | ir.TensorProtocol | Sequence[int], )
methods.description: Creates an IR node representing an operator call with specified attributes and inputs, acting as a wrapper for recording nodes during ONNX graph construction.

methods.name: Sequence[ir.Value] higher_order_cond( cond: ir.Value, true_func: ir.Function, false_func: ir.Function, inputs: Sequence[ir.Value], )
methods.description: Implements a higher-order conditional operator that constructs 'If' nodes with true and false branches, renaming outputs to ensure uniqueness.

methods.name: Sequence[ir.Value] higher_order_scan( body_func: ir.Function, scan_inits: Sequence[ir.Value], scan_inputs: Sequence[ir.Value], additional_inputs: Sequence[ir.Value] | None, reverse: bool = False, )
methods.description: Implements a higher-order scan (loop) operator constructing a 'Scan' node with a body function, managing subgraph inputs and renaming outputs to avoid conflicts.
